partners.mechanism_chain: CLCN5 (HGNC:2355) —DISRUPTS→ Phosphate reabsorption in renal tubule (R-HSA-8963684); Phosphate reabsorption in renal tubule (R-HSA-8963684) —LEADS_TO→ Hypophosphatemia (HP:0002148); CASQ2 (HGNC:2374) —DISRUPTS→ Cardiac calcium handling and release (GO:0003015); Cardiac calcium handling and release (GO:0003015) —DISRUPTS→ Intracellular calcium concentration (CHEBI:17593); Intracellular calcium concentration (CHEBI:17593) —LEADS_TO→ Ventricular tachycardia (HP:0001669).
